name: GL_PURGE_SETUP_DETAILS_
description: This table stores the number of years to retain archived data, also known as the retention period, as well as the retention level when the retention location is Oracle Cloud ERP. The retention levels are business object, ledger, or a combination of ledger and legal entity.

columns.name: BUSINESS_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Business object associated with the specified retention period. Some valid values are ORA_GL_JOURNALS for General Ledger Journals and ORA_GL_BALANCES for General Ledger Balances.

columns.name: GL_PURGE_SETUP_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Purge Setup Details.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: For all the retention levels that is ledger, ledger and legal entity, ledger and balancing segment values, this value represents the primary or secondary ledger identifier associated with the specified retention period. The retention period applies to all reporting currencies associated with the ledger.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier associated with the specified retention period. A value of -99 indicates all legal entities.

columns.name: RETENTION_YEARS
columns.description: Number of years to retain the archived data for the business object. Also known as the retention period.
